assumptions: One-loop flow of a quartic ansatz with one coupling κ; both cases (scale set, scale free) computed; parts a and f not blind. a, d, e, f confirmed; the cutoff part of b (1 against 2 components) refuted; c refuted by its wording.
guard: Sign of 2λ − κ at the Koide point
obligation: The sign follows only if two things are required: scale free, and the scale shall arise. With the actual component numbers the flow shifts K off ⅔. Deferred idea I4 is met but not implemented. OP3 remains open.

title: The scale-free shift of K is related neither to δ = 2/9 nor to any other setting, and the frame difference cannot cancel it
excerpt: Ergebnis H151: Die Koide-Verschiebung aus H150 hängt weder mit δ = 2/9 noch mit einer anderen Setzung zusammen, und die Frame-Differenz kann sie nicht aufheben
assumptions: Scale-free flow of H150; comparison catalogue of settings fixed before the computation (second addendum on the frame difference after the run of a–d, before e). a, c, d, e confirmed; b partly.
guard: Origin of the scale-free shift of K
obligation: The shift is start dependent, not a fixed number; no hit above chance expectation. No derivation of δ or of K follows. OP3 remains open.

title: The complete scale-free ansatz fixes neither K nor δ; the cubic norm selects δ = 0 or π/3, two equal masses
excerpt: Ergebnis H152: Der vollständige skalenfreie Ansatz legt weder K noch δ fest; die kubische Norm wählt δ = 0 oder π/3, also zwei gleiche Massen
assumptions: All Z₃ ⋊ Z₂-invariant quartic terms and the back-reaction of HS(3); 144 starting points. H152a–e confirmed, all as predicted.
guard: Scale-free route to K and δ
obligation: Three different masses occur in none of the cases computed; the measured K value used here rested on an older tau mass and is corrected in H154 without change of a decision. OP3 remains open.

title: A normalisation selects only the starting ray; only the restriction of the loop to the subalgebra {1, U} gives K = ⅔ exactly
excerpt: Ergebnis H153: Eine Normierung wählt nur die Startlinie; nur die Einschränkung auf die Unteralgebra {1, U} gibt K = ⅔ exakt
assumptions: Scale-free flow with three normalisations of the two norms. H153a, c, d confirmed; H153b confirmed except one sub-prediction.
guard: Normalisation 1:2 and the degrees of freedom in the loop
obligation: Restricting the loop to {1, U} is a setting about the degrees of freedom, not a consequence of the algebra (H154). OP3 remains open.

title: The algebra does not force the loop over {1, U}; the deviation of the measured Koide value from ⅔ is measurement noise (0.43σ, entirely from the tau mass)
excerpt: Ergebnis H154: Die Algebra erzwingt die Schleife über {1, U} nicht; die Abweichung von ⅔ ist Messrauschen (0,43σ, ganz aus m_τ)
assumptions: K = 0.6666645 ± 0.0000051 with m_τ = 1776.93 ± 0.09 MeV; one-loop QED running; parts a, g, h not blind. H154a–h confirmed.
guard: Subalgebra restriction and the measured deviation from ⅔
obligation: The value m_τ = 1776.969 MeV is a conditional prediction (if K = ⅔ holds exactly for pole masses), open. Koide holds for pole masses, not for running masses at a common scale. OP3 remains open.

title: With a set scale the exchange symmetry holds K = ⅔ without a heavy U′; running disturbs only at second order; δ = 2/9 remains a parameter
excerpt: Ergebnis H155: Mit gesetzter Skala hält die Tauschsymmetrie K = ⅔ ohne schweres U′; das Laufen stört erst in zweiter Ordnung; δ = 2/9 bleibt ein Parameter
assumptions: Scale set; equal mass terms and equal quartic couplings in the plane {1, U}; part a not blind. H155a, b confirmed; H155c refuted (in favour of Koide); H155d refuted by its wording; one addition is marked as a post-hoc exploration.
guard: Koide value under a set scale and the Brannen phase
obligation: δ = 2/9 requires one fitted parameter R*; the one comparison counted as a hit lies 63σ off in δ and is no derivation. Scale and exchange symmetry are set. OP3 remains open.

title: The algebra does not require equal mass terms; they follow only if the exchange J is required as a symmetry
excerpt: Ergebnis H156: Die Algebra verlangt μ_A² = μ_B² nicht; gleiche Massen folgen erst, wenn der Tausch J als Symmetrie gefordert wird
assumptions: Invariants computed in the plane {1, U}; candidate symmetries SO(2), Z₄, Z₂ = ⟨J⟩, D₄; parts a, d not blind. H156a, b, d confirmed; H156c partly.
guard: Postulate of equal standing of the matter and the tachyon frame
obligation: J is an isometry but neither an automorphism nor an antiautomorphism; the algebra does not supply it. The postulate was adopted by the author on 26 November 2026 as a working assumption and is not derived. OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: Route A and the relative CP sign do not depend on the charge axis e₈; with e₇ the charge extends the octonionic charge of one copy
excerpt: Ergebnis H162: Weg A und das relative CP-Vorzeichen hängen nicht an der Achse e₈; mit e₇ setzt die Ladung die oktonionische Ladung einer Kopie fort
assumptions: Sedenion carrier with charge of the form ½ − (i/2)L_u on the colour-neutral block; largely not blind (a, b, d argued by hand beforehand); part c numerical only; e is an exploration. H162a–d confirmed.
guard: Charge axis (CT-003) and the statements conditional on it
obligation: CT-003 stays a placeholder: the choice between the ψ-fixed axis e₈ and an axis faithful to a copy (e₇) is not decided. By r65 the relative sign depends on the setting that the same side of the multiplication carries the family in both sectors. Stage B of H125 stays open. OP1–OP5 remain open.

title: The counting rule is adopted as a postulate; β_sym = 0.5494056410 is computed from it
excerpt: Die Zählregel wird als Postulat angenommen, im selben Sinn wie die Frame-Gleichberechtigung (r63.7):
assumptions: Postulate r67.P: weight 2 per spin in the matter frame, Casimir area √(j(j+1)), the frame T counts only j = ½ with one bit; the assignment of the rules to the frames is part of the postulate.
guard: Counting postulate (OP1)
obligation: The postulate is named, not derived, and closes no open problem. OP1 remains open in the form: derive the counting postulate. Earlier layers keep their printed rounded-input values.

title: Recalculation of all numbers depending on β_sym, γ_L or γ_M at the exact value: no verdict changes
excerpt: **Erkundung, kein Test** (keine Vorab-Notiz, kein Entscheidungskriterium).
assumptions: Exploration without advance note or decision criterion; measured values are those already held in the record, none counts as a test of a prediction; scripts that use 0.5493 only for illustrative numbers were not rerun individually.
guard: Sensitivity of the dependent numbers to the reference value of β_sym
obligation: The σ distances are descriptions of position, not tests. Hit counts of the mask scans change through a raster effect and are not a measure. No statement on the origin of β_sym follows. OP1 remains open.

title: Naming convention: rest frame R, matter frame M, dual frame T, light point P; Re and Im sector of the leptons
excerpt: Die Buchstaben M, T, P, R und alle bisherigen Namen bleiben gültig; ältere Runden werden nicht
assumptions: Author decision of 26 November 2026; convention only, no computation, no test; the Re/Im sector names apply to leptons only and as a reading under H99.
guard: Naming only; no frame identification derived
obligation: Names change no statement and no status. Which frame the data are compared in (M rather than T) is not derived. Earlier layers and published versions are not renamed. OP1-OP5 remain open.

title: The common lepton offset is a scale-free rotation angle; scale and conjugation term are excluded as its universal source
excerpt: Der neutrale Sektor schließt Skala und Konjugationsterm als universelle Quelle des Versatzes aus
assumptions: Tree model of H167 written for the Im and Re sector; Brannen form with K = 2/3 under J; circulant sector, tree level, H99; verdict partly (criterion scale free met). Recorded in r73.4.
guard: Value of the rotation angle phi (OP3)
obligation: A common rotation chi -> chi + phi shifts both minima exactly by phi for every phi; it does not fix phi. The twofold degeneracy of each minimum is lifted only by the branch choice (H222). OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: The sign of the cubic spectral invariant cos 3delta (proportional to det Y) chooses the data branch in both lepton sectors without a scale
excerpt: Das Vorzeichen der kubischen Spektralinvariante wählt den Zweig in beiden Lepton-Sektoren — ohne Skala
assumptions: Rotation of H221; rule larger cos 3delta for phi = 0.01 to 0.06; part a not blind, b and c partly not blind, d and e blind; recorded in r73.5.
guard: Sign of the branch-choice term (setting of the author)
obligation: The sign q < 0 is set by the author (28 November 2026); it follows neither from J, nor from stability, nor from a natural parent term (r73.6). Loosening J at order six would replace it by a rule change and was not adopted (H229, r74.2). OP3 remains open.

title: The value phi = 0.0395773 of the common lepton angle stays a measured input
excerpt: Bilanz: Seit r73.4 sitzt die offene Wahl im Wert von φ.
assumptions: Record round r73 of the tests H213-H227; Wigner rotation (H224), modulus minimum (H225) and simple exchange-breaking terms (H226) give no derivation.
guard: Value of phi (OP3)
obligation: phi is the one measured number of the lepton picture; whether it is an equilibrium value or an initial or boundary condition is not decided. OP3 remains open.

title: Three numbers carry all six lepton masses; recorded prediction sum m_nu = 59.30 +- 0.24 meV, m_beta = 8.87 meV, m_betabeta 1.29-4.00 meV
excerpt: Drei Zahlen tragen alle sechs Leptonenmassen; die absolute Neutrinoskala ist vorhergesagt, das Skalenverhältnis ist frei
assumptions: Inputs phi, mu_e, mu_nu; K = 2/3 under J, Brannen form, H99, branch sign set, normal ordering, pole masses; mu_nu from Delta m^2_31; masses not blind, m_beta and m_betabeta new; verdict partly. Recorded in r73.10 and in the register r75.
guard: Absolute neutrino scale against future data
obligation: The predictions are open: a measured sum m_nu < 58 meV or an established inverted ordering refutes the picture. The scale ratio mu_nu/mu_e is not a frame number. OP3 and OP4 remain open.

title: Double counting settled: phi carries the lepton offset, the coefficient q of H167 only the sign of the branch choice
excerpt: φ trägt den Versatz, q ist nur ein Vorzeichen. Kein früheres Urteil kippt
assumptions: Tree model of H225, branch after H222 (q < 0), data x and x_nu (H213), pole masses (H214); readings Q and Phi not blind, mixed reading M and part B blind. 2-sigma range q in [-0.029, 0]. Recorded in r74.10.
guard: Value of phi (OP3)
obligation: No verdict of H221-H235 changes and the H227 predictions are unaffected. Future computations use q -> 0- with the offset in phi; a finite q would need a justification as a scale part. phi stays a measured input; OP3 remains open.

title: No route fixes the lepton angle phi (H228-H235); the author leaves phi open and the strand rests
excerpt: Autorentscheidung 28.11.2026, 15:41: φ = 0,0395773 bleibt offen (gemessene Eingabe), der
assumptions: Record round r74 of H228-H236 and the exploration k449; no new computation; each cited test with Python and an independent Wolfram cross-check.
guard: Value of phi (OP3)
obligation: Asymptote, loosened J, frame transfer, expansion clock, backward search, locking, fine step and Casimir twist do not fix phi; at every equilibrium phi is the mean of the two sector offsets. The strand rests by author decision; OP3 remains open.

title: Dated register of the model state and its predictions for version v5.6.0 (Stand 28 November 2026)

assumptions: Standing rule of the author of 28 November 2026; register only, no computation; values copied from the cited advance and result notes; experiment sensitivities are literature planning values, not recomputed.
guard: Open pre-registered predictions against future data
obligation: Criteria and verdicts are those of the source notes; corrections only in a new version with a stated reason, never a readjustment after a measurement. Tests H173-H212 are not yet recorded as a layer. OP1-OP5 remain open.
